WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, term_start, TRY_CAST(term_start AS DATE) AS start_date, substr(term_start, 1, 4) AS start_year
    FROM legislators_terms
    WHERE term_number = 0 AND term_start >= '1917-01-01' AND term_start <= '1999-12-31'
),
cohort_with_max_end AS (
    SELECT c.id_bioguide, c.start_year, MAX(TRY_CAST(l.term_end AS DATE)) AS max_term_end
    FROM cohort c
    LEFT JOIN legislators_terms l ON c.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    GROUP BY c.id_bioguide, c.start_year
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as legislators_starting_in_1999
FROM cohort_with_max_end
WHERE start_year = '1999'
